newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease on expiry, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease on expiry, seen rangebound.

text.p: Austrian shares slipped on Friday to end the week softer amid a smooth futures and options expiry, and traders saw the index next week locked in a range between 1,200 and 1,220 points, for want of external impetus.
Traders said another sharp fall on Wall Street could put pressure on prices in Vienna, but the market was basically expected to remain friendly.
"We have no leader in the market," one trader said.
Another expected the index to rise on Monday, driven by second line trade.
"We will go up on Monday," he said. "The shares in second line trade are all interesting."
The ATX index of 21 blue chips shed 3.57 points or 0.29 percent to 1,209.53. Among its constituents eight shares rose, 12 fell and one remained unchanged.
The March future contract lost 4.6 points at 1,209.5.
The leading decliner was highgrade steelmaker Boehler Uddeholm, tumbling 2.47 percent to 827.90 schillings.
VA Stahl was the top gainer, adding 1.17 percent to 478.10 schillings.
